attacks.name: Lashing Tendrils
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Reel In|: After this attack is resolved, if the target character is Size 3 or less, it may be Pushed Toward this character |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Emotional Agitation
steps: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| and |§poison§Poison| special conditions.

superPowers.name: Guardian of the Nexus of All Realities
superPowers.body: Choose this character or another allied character within |!range| 3 of it and Place the chosen character within |!range| 3 of its current position. A character can be affected by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: All Who Know Fear Burn at the Man-Thing‘s Touch
superPowers.body: After an attack made by this character is resolved or after an attack targeting this character is resolved, if |!damage| was dealt and the enemy character is within |!range| 2 of this character, the enemy character gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

superPowers.name: Moss and Mud and Swamp
superPowers.body: When this character is defending, enemy characters do not roll additional dice for |!critical| results in their attack rolls.
